subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class VI

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class VI English annual syllabus 2026-27, built on the NCERT textbook Poorvi (NCF-SE 2023) that CBSE schools use
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. CBSE does not publish a line-by-line English syllabus below Class 9; this list follows a state education department's year plan for the NCERT book Poorvi, read through a text summary of the PDF. Chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Listens to talks and announcements: orders events, marks true or false, fills in notes.
Takes part in role play and pair and group discussion.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Recites poems and retells a poem as a story.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Frames questions for a guest and shares experiences in full sentences.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads folk tales, stories and poems for plot, character and theme.
Notices personification, simile, metaphor, alliteration, imagery and rhyme scheme.
outcomes.note: Poems are read with questions on figurative language; rhyme schemes are not asked about.

outcomes.text: Writes descriptive and narrative paragraphs, and reasons for a preference.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes a diary entry, a message and a letter.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes sentences from a fact sheet or notes.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Turns a story into a conversation, and writes short poems.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses present and past tenses, simple, continuous and perfect.
Uses countable and uncountable nouns, adjectives, adverbs and prepositions.
Uses contractions, apostrophes, exclamations and questions.
Uses compound words, roots and suffixes, and linking words.
Uses words that sound alike, and words of the same and opposite meaning.
